title: Fix loop condition op validation to ADR-027's eight ops, checked at load
goal: Validate abort_when.op and single-condition until.op at template load against ADR-027's eight ops, implement all eight ops in every evaluator with a refusing *) branch, and refuse ne/in at load.

steps.description: Write failing tests for R1 and R3: one case per condition field asserts that an op outside the eight-op set — including the old spellings ne and in — is refused at template load with a message that names the loop, the field, the bad op, and the valid set. Confirm every test fails before touching any implementation file.

Write failing tests for R2 and R4: assert that each of the eight ops evaluates correctly in each of the three condition fields (substring match for contains, extended-regex for matches, numeric comparison for gt/gte/lt/lte with an explicit error — not silent false — on a non-numeric operand, equality for eq/neq); assert that each evaluator's *) branch refuses rather than silently skips. Add a guard test for R5 that a template using op: eq in every condition field loads and runs unchanged. Confirm every test fails before touching any implementation file.

Fix load-time op validation in template.sh: add an op check for abort_when against the full eight-op set (eq|neq|gt|gte|lt|lte|contains|matches), add the same check for single-condition until, and widen the existing exit_when multi-condition check from eq|ne to the same eight ops. Run the R1 and R3 tests and confirm they pass.

Fix the evaluators in cycle-orchestrator.sh: add gt/gte/lt/lte/contains/matches cases with numeric guards to the abort_when, until, and exit_when evaluators; rename ne to neq; remove in; add a *) branch to every evaluator case statement that emits an error and refuses evaluation. Run the R2, R4, and R5 tests and confirm they pass.

Amend ADR-027 with a dated entry stating the supported op set is eq|neq|gt|gte|lt|lte|contains|matches, enforced at template load; populate or update the Enforced by section naming the specific test files that enforce each changed or new statement. Remove ADR-027 from config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt because enforcement is now complete. Run npm run lint to confirm lint-adr-enforced-by passes.
